subject: Go/No-Go: Hosted Canary Rollouts GA (target Oct 24)
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 17, 2024 at 9:12 AM
Subject: Go/No-Go: Hosted Canary Rollouts GA (target Oct 24)

Hi all —

We’re approaching the GA window for Hosted canary rollouts (Console workflow + routing/policy + telemetry + audit logs). I’d like to lock the go/no-go by Tue EOD (Oct 22) so Releases can keep the train on track for Thu Oct 24.

Please reply with:
1) GO / NO-GO
2) Any remaining blockers + owner + date
3) Confirmation you’ve reviewed the GA readiness checklist (attached)

Current plan (for confirmation):
- Thu Oct 24: GA announcement + docs publish + default-off flag flips for eligible plans
- Staged enablement: us-east first, then us-west/eu as SLO dashboards stay green
- Guardrails required by default for >0% candidate on Hosted routes (unless enterprise override)

Known open items as of today:
- Propagation race fix in one region (PR 18537) — needs final verification in staging
- Audit diff payload review (PII/retention) — Security signoff
- SRE paging thresholds for rollout staleness + dashboards link to runbook

Attachments:
- Hosted_Rollouts_GA_Release_Checklist_v7.pdf
- Hosted_Canary_GA_Launch_Brief_draft.docx

Thanks,
Marissa
Product Lead, Redwood Inference


---

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Oct 17, 2024 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: Hosted Canary Rollouts GA (target Oct 24)

GO from Console/Tooling.

What I’ve reviewed / status:
- Wizard + step editor + guardrails UI + preview effective routing: in RC state behind GA flag
- Activity/audit timeline rendering: landed; empty + error states implemented
- Error handling for RBAC/entitlement failures: we now surface actionable messages ("insufficient permission to pause rollout" etc)

Remaining items (not blockers):
- Copy edits for confirmation dialogs (pause vs rollback language) — Kenji/Svetlana pairing, by Mon
- One more pass on accessibility focus order in the stepper — already in QA queue

Hard requirement for launch: ensure backend returns stable rollout “resolved policy version” so the preview doesn’t flicker during propagation. Chloe says this is addressed with the monotonic version check.

-Dylan
Engineering Lead, Console


---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Oct 18, 2024 at 8:27 AM
Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: Hosted Canary Rollouts GA (target Oct 24)

Conditional GO from Platform, assuming we close two verification items.

1) Propagation race fix (PR 18537):
- Patch is in staging as of last night.
- We need to see 24h clean on the “policy staleness p99” panel across all Hosted regions.
Owner: Ethan/Jordan. ETA: Monday 10/21 morning for update.

2) Deterministic evaluation at high QPS:
- We ran the load test at 2.5x typical control-plane QPS; evaluation stayed within budget.
- I want one more run with concurrent rollout edits + forced region failover.
Owner: Benji + SRE to assist. ETA: Monday EOD.

Not blockers / already done:
- v2 schema migration reads are backward compatible; writes are gated by entitlement
- Validation rules are in (sum weights, required baseline, max candidate cap on first step)

If the two verification items are green by Tue, I’m a full GO.

Priya
Engineering Sponsor (Platform)


---

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Oct 21, 2024 at 10:14 AM
Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: Hosted Canary Rollouts GA (target Oct 24)

GO from SRE provided we ship with the staged rollout + alerting config exactly as in the checklist.

SRE notes:
- Dashboards: baseline vs candidate compare view is in place; cardinality controls look acceptable (variant label limited to baseline/candidate, no free-form)
- Alerts:
  - “Policy propagation staleness > 60s (p99) for 10m” = page during staged enablement; after GA, downgrade to ticket unless customer impact
  - “Rollout edit error rate > 1%” = ticket (page only if blocks rollback)
- Runbook: Hosted rollout pause/rollback steps are ready, with explicit verification steps (propagation version + traffic weights)

The one thing I want in release comms (internal) is a clear rule on when we force 0% candidate for customers vs ask them to pause in Console. The incident last month was mostly confusion/latency.

If Connor confirms the flag flip plan and the staged region order, SRE is fully comfortable.

Sean
SRE Lead


---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Oct 21, 2024 at 3:46 PM
Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: Hosted Canary Rollouts GA (target Oct 24)

Security signoff: GO.

What we checked:
- Audit events present for create/update/pause/rollback, with actor attribution and before/after diffs.
- PII review: diff payload excludes prompt bodies and excludes full request/response content. Model identifiers + route IDs are OK.
- Retention/export: events follow existing audit pipeline retention defaults; export format is consistent with other control-plane events.

Conditions / follow-ups (not launch blockers):
- Please ensure docs do not imply that audit events include token-level payloads (we’ve had customers misread this).
- We should add a specific entry to the security FAQ clarifying what is and isn’t captured for rollout changes.
Owner: Naomi/Wei. ETA: post-GA doc patch is fine.

Marcus
Security Engineering Lead


---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Oct 22, 2024 at 9:08 AM
Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: Hosted Canary Rollouts GA (target Oct 24)

Release Eng: GO.

Flag flip plan (per SRE request):
- Thu 10/24 10:00 PT: enable entitlements + GA feature flag for internal + dogfood orgs (all regions)
- Thu 10/24 11:00 PT: enable for eligible customer orgs in us-east only
- Thu 10/24 14:00 PT: expand to us-west if dashboards green; EU next business day

Rollback criteria:
- If control-plane staleness p99 > 60s sustained 10m OR if rollout edit endpoints > 2% error rate sustained 10m: revert flags + freeze edits
- If customer-facing 5xx spike correlated with rollout activation: force candidate 0% + page routing oncall

I’ll send the internal comms note with the above plus runbook links.

Connor
Release Engineering


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paula Mendes <paula.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Oct 22, 2024 at 4:48 PM
Subject: Re: Go/No-Go: Hosted Canary Rollouts GA (target Oct 24)

Thanks all — calling this a GO for Thu Oct 24 with Connor’s staged enablement plan.

Priya: please confirm the two verification items are green tomorrow AM; if anything regresses, we’ll hold the customer-facing enablement in us-east until resolved (but still ship docs + internal enablement).

Sean: agreed on the rule. We’ll add a short “When to force 0% candidate vs pause” section to the internal comms + support playbook.

Marcus: noted on audit docs language; Wei/Naomi will incorporate.

Next steps:
- Connor to send final release comms + flag times + runbook links
- Paula to sanity-check the GA release notes for limitations (stickiness/streaming semantics)
- I’ll post the go decision + schedule in the #eng-releases thread and update PM-641

Marissa
Product Lead, Redwood Inference
